summary: QRH’s supported configuration is provisional because the latest call ended with QRH declining Entrata over price and contract terms. callsUsed.title: Entrata // QRH Management - Deep Dive
callsUsed.brief: Beaumon and Oscar from Entrata, along with Greg from QRH MGMT, discussed Entrata's property management software solutions, focusing on Greg's dissatisfaction with his current vendor, ResMan, and his need for a more efficient and reliable system. Greg expressed significant concerns about pricing, customer service, and product functionality, while Beaumon highlighted Entrata's integrated platform, AI capabilities, and commitment to partnership. The conversation concluded with plans for a demo of Entrata's core accounting module and a request for detailed pricing information to assess the value proposition.

callsUsed.title: Call with QRH MGMT - Greg Meech
callsUsed.brief: Greg from QRH MGMT is exploring Entrata as a potential replacement for his current provider, Rezmin, due to dissatisfaction with service and costs. He is particularly interested in Entrata's accounting capabilities, ability to manage separate entities, and efficient migration process, while emphasizing his need for accessible human support and a streamlined experience. The call concluded with a rescheduled meeting to include an account executive for further discussion and demo.

callsUsed.title: QRH Management / Entrata - MSA Discussion
callsUsed.brief: Beaumon and Staska from Entrata, along with Greg from QRH Management, discussed contract terms, focusing on pricing, fees, and property removal clauses. Greg raised concerns about potential price increases, unclear definitions, and unfavorable contract language, while Entrata emphasized the need for predictable revenue and explained standard SaaS practices. Both parties agreed to further discussions and potential revisions to reach a mutually beneficial agreement.

callsUsed.title: Entrata / QRH - Entrata Accounting Demo
callsUsed.brief: Beaumon, David and Rolanda from Entrata, along with Greg from QRH Management, discussed Entrata's support philosophy and structure, highlighting its customizable nature and robust help center. They also delved into Entrata's comprehensive training offerings, including the self-paced Entrata Academy and live webinars, and explored the software's accounting capabilities, emphasizing its single database architecture and real-time data visibility as key differentiators. The conversation concluded with scheduling a follow-up demo to further explore the software's functionalities and address any remaining questions.

callsUsed.title: Entrata / QRH - Accounting Demo
callsUsed.brief: Beaumon and Rolanda from Entrata, along with Greg from QRH Management, discussed Entrata's capabilities for asset tracking, inventory management, and accounting, with a particular focus on Greg's concerns regarding vendor payments, 1099 processing, and ACH/wire transfers. Greg expressed significant frustration with his current system's limitations, especially concerning accurate financial reporting and vendor payment workflows, and was interested in Entrata's solutions for these pain points. The conversation highlighted Entrata's potential to streamline these processes, including vendor management, bill pay, and purchase order integrations, with a follow-up meeting scheduled to further explore these functionalities.

callsUsed.title: Entrata / QRH - Demo #3: Core & Accounting
callsUsed.brief: Rolanda and Beaumon from Entrata, along with Greg from QRH Management, discussed Entrata's capabilities for ACH payments, asset tracking, bank reconciliation, and journal entries, highlighting how the system can streamline these processes. They also delved into Entrata's reporting features, resident management, payment options, and fraud mitigation tools, with Greg expressing particular interest in enhanced reporting customization and payment security. The conversation also touched upon the challenges of managing properties in challenging markets and the potential for Entrata to address some of these operational hurdles.

callsUsed.title: Entrata / QRH - Resident Management and Operations Demo #4
callsUsed.brief: Rolanda and Beaumon from Entrata, along with Greg from QRH Management, discussed Entrata's property management software, focusing on its lead tracking, marketing capabilities, AI integrations, and customizable application process. Greg expressed significant concerns about the cost and the perceived value proposition compared to his current system, while Rolanda and Beaumon highlighted Entrata's advanced features and potential for streamlining operations and improving occupancy. The conversation also touched upon operational challenges, including electrician issues and deposit alternatives, with Entrata offering solutions and further demonstrations to address Greg's needs.

callsUsed.title: Entrata / QRH - Resident Management & Operations Demo #5
callsUsed.brief: Rolanda and Beaumon from Entrata, along with Greg from QRH Management, discussed Entrata's platform capabilities, focusing on the leasing, resident management, and maintenance workflows. Key highlights included Entrata's automated screening and lease execution, its comprehensive resident portal with mobile optimization for signing, and its advanced maintenance app with offline capabilities and integrated communication logging. The conversation also touched upon Entrata's AI-driven renewal and payment collection tools, as well as its robust work order management system, all aimed at streamlining operations and improving efficiency for property management teams.

callsUsed.title: Call with QRH Management - Robyn bro
callsUsed.brief: Oscar from Entrata spoke with Robyn from QRH Management regarding her demo request. Robyn, whose company is switching from Resman to Entrata, sought information on the software's functionality and how it compares to their current system. Oscar confirmed the switch and assured Robyn that Entrata is intuitive and user-friendly.

callsUsed.title: Entrata / QRH - Pricing & Contracts
callsUsed.brief: Beaumon and Vincent from Entrata, along with Greg from QRH Management, discussed a new offer for QRH Management, which included a year of free Entrata and reduced bundle pricing. However, Greg expressed strong objections to Entrata's bundled product strategy, high software costs compared to his current provider, and long-term contract requirements, ultimately declining the offer due to perceived lack of value and financial constraints. Despite acknowledging Entrata's superior product, Greg emphasized his need for a significantly lower, unbundled price, citing industry trends towards cheaper software and his own company's financial struggles.
